entities.summary: Radical Liberal Revolution, a transformative movement in Ecuador (1895–1912). Emerged from Liberal Revolution under Alfaro and Ecuador consecrated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus. Catalyzed Eloy Alfaro and Alfaro lynched and burned in Quito — January 28, 1912.
